display.purpose: Page-level headers only (player/team name at top of a detail view). Rare.

data.purpose: Every stat, line, odd, prediction, and edge value; always tabular-figure monospace.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Behind an actively-selected edge or the primary CTA on hover. Never on neutral elements.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and hover feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action on a screen (e.g. "Generate parlay").
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--signal-green, oklch(0.72 0.16 150)); color: var(--ink-black, oklch(0.09 0 0)); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--signal-green-deep, oklch(0.50 0.14 150)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--signal-green, oklch(0.72 0.16 150)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink, oklch(0.96 0.004 150)); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.26 0.006 150)); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-raised, oklch(0.185 0.005 150)); border-color: var(--ink, oklch(0.96 0.004 150)); }

components.name: Edge Badge
components.description: Flags a line worth a second look — calibration warning, moved line, correlation risk.
components.css: .ds-badge-edge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: var(--edge-amber, oklch(0.75 0.15 70)); color: var(--ink-black, oklch(0.09 0 0)); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Data Row
components.description: A single scannable row: player/stat label + monospace tabular prediction vs. line vs. edge.
components.html: Player Name · PTS27.4+5.2%
components.css: .ds-data-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-data-row:hover { background: var(--surface-raised, oklch(0.185 0.005 150)); } .ds-data-row-label { font-family: var(--font-geist-sans); font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink, oklch(0.96 0.004 150)); } .ds-data-row-value { font-family: var(--font-geist-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted, oklch(0.60 0.006 150)); } .ds-data-row-edge { color: var(--signal-green, oklch(0.72 0.16 150)); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--surface-raised, oklch(0.185 0.005 150)); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.96 0.004 150)); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans); font-size: 0.9375rem; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.26 0.006 150)); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, oklch(0.60 0.006 150)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--signal-green, oklch(0.72 0.16 150)); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Top or bottom navigation item with a signal-green active underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { font-family: var(--font-geist-sans); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, oklch(0.60 0.006 150)); text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--ink, oklch(0.96 0.004 150)); } .ds-nav-item-active { color: var(--ink, oklch(0.96 0.004 150)); border-bottom-color: var(--signal-green, oklch(0.72 0.16 150)); }

narrative.overview: Playstat reads like a terminal built by someone who trusts the numbers, not a SaaS dashboard trying to look trustworthy. The surface is near-black, quiet, and gets out of the way; the one signal color that lives on top of it — a controlled, deep green — is reserved for the moments a prediction actually clears the bar against the market. Nothing else on screen competes with that signal. Data is set in a tabular monospace so columns of odds and predicted lines line up the way a spreadsheet or a terminal would, while UI chrome (nav, labels, buttons) stays in a clean technical sans. This system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS-dashboard-in-a-box look — pastel KPI tiles, rounded-everything card grids, gradient accents — and it rejects actual sportsbook chrome — promo banners, gamified color, odds-app skins. The tone is analyst, not marketing; precision, not promotion.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black terminal surface, restrained to a single signal color used sparingly and meaningfully
Tabular monospace for every number; sans only for UI chrome and prose
Flat by default — depth comes from tonal layering (surface steps), not shadows
Motion limited to responsive feedback: state changes and transitions, no choreography
Every colored number carries its calibration context nearby, never floats alone

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Green appears only when a real, calibration-checked edge exists — never as branding, never on a button that isn't the primary action, never as page furniture. Its rarity is what makes it mean something.

rules.name: The No-Tint-Drift Rule
rules.body: Every neutral (Surface, Ink, Muted, Border) shares Signal Green's hue (150°) at near-zero chroma — one palette at every step, not a neutral gray system with a color bolted on.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any numeral rendered in the Data role uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns of stats stay vertically aligned.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; depth comes from the tonal ladder. Shadows appear only as Signal Glow, and only in response to a signal-colored state.

dos: Do keep Signal Green reserved for real, calibration-checked edges and the one primary action per screen.
Do set every stat, line, odd, and prediction in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
Do build depth with the Ink Black → Surface → Surface Raised ladder, not shadows.
Do pair a colored number with its calibration context rather than letting a bold green figure stand alone.
donts: Don't build the generic SaaS-dashboard-in-a-box look — no pastel KPI tiles, no rounded-everything card grids, no gradient accents.
Don't borrow sportsbook chrome — no promo banners, no gamified color, no odds-app skin.
Don't use border-left/border-right accent stripes on rows or panels.
Don't apply drop shadows on the near-black surface for routine elevation — it reads as murky, not layered.
Don't mix Edge Amber and Signal Green in the same element; they're distinct signals and must stay visually separable.
